notes.why_in_news: Election Commission digitised over 68% of enumeration forms in the second phase of Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in 12 States and UTs.
notes.fact_box: As of November 27, 2025, 34,86,60,338 enumeration forms (68%) have been digitised in the second phase of SIR in 12 States and UTs.
